- Soviet space program dagger: Accepted. The source Overview table includes Soviet space program with a dagger/defunct marker and founded 1955; the Launch capability table also includes Soviet space program †. The staged Agency and Country dagger markers are source-faithful. The title does not claim currently active agencies only.
- ESA Country normalization: Accepted. The source Overview table represents ESA via multiple member-country flags and the ESA row/founded 1975. The staged normalized value "European Space Agency member states" is documented and avoids an unwieldy 22-country cell without changing the sponsor semantics.
- Founded-year spot-checks: Passed. Current-entity-year extraction is consistently documented and matches spot-checks: CONAE 1991, ASA 2018, ESA 1975, ISRO 1969, NATA 2023, POLSA 2014, NASA 1958, and Soviet space program 1955.
